_comment: Example .metadata.json structure for cc-track spec directories
_usage: This file is automatically created in .claude/specs/NNN-feature-name/ when using /specify or /migrate commands
_task_id_description: REQUIRED - Numeric ID matching the spec directory prefix (e.g., '001' for '001-feature-name/')
_feature_name_description: REQUIRED - Kebab-case feature name matching the spec directory name
_branch_description: REQUIRED - Git branch name for this feature (usually matches directory name)
_status_description: REQUIRED - Current status of the feature. Valid values: 'draft', 'in_progress', 'completed'

_status_values.draft: Specification phase - requirements being defined via /specify
_status_values.completed: Feature complete - all validation passed, ready for merge

_started_description: REQUIRED - ISO 8601 timestamp when feature work began (set by /specify or /migrate)
_completed_description: OPTIONAL - ISO 8601 timestamp when feature was completed (set by /complete-task). Omit if not completed.
_github_description: OPTIONAL - GitHub integration data. Omit entire 'github' object if not using GitHub integration.

_github_fields.issue: GitHub issue number linked to this feature
_github_fields.url: Full URL to the GitHub issue

notes: Optional freeform notes about the feature. Can be multiline string.
_notes_description: OPTIONAL - Any additional context or notes about the feature. Omit if not needed.
